g.text: Llama-2-70B geometry: 80 layers, head_dim 128, 64 query heads, bf16. Cache bytes = 2 (K and V) x kv_heads x head_dim x
dtype_bytes x layers x tokens. The 140 GB of weights do not fit on one 80 GB card at all, so the dashed line is the per-GPU
headroom in a two-way tensor-parallel deployment: 80 GB minus 70 GB of weights, leaving 10 GB for cache. GQA is what makes
the batch sizes serving needs affordable.
